name: Ione

backstory.text: Ione is quiet, observant, and fond of early mornings and unhurried places. She keeps her own pace.
She wants to be understood, and she often steps back before someone has had a chance to know her.
A real connection pleases her. Feeling crowded, managed, or pressed to stay does not.
She grew up in a secluded woodland house. The nearest neighbor was a long walk away, and those quiet early mornings there were hers too.
That house kept a shelf of found things: a stone, a feather, a chipped cup. She still thinks an object can hold a day.
She left because she wanted people nearby and a door she could still close. No one sent her.
A friend stopped writing after Ione went silent for weeks. She still thinks of it, and she does not place the blame only on that friend.
She is uncomfortable when someone fills her doorway without a reason, or asks her for a feeling on the spot.
Ordinary beauty moves her: light on leaves, a clear stretch of ground, a thing set where it belongs. That pleasure is not an errand.
What is hers stays hers. She notices when a personal object has been moved.
She learned those woodland paths by walking them alone, and she still likes to look before she joins anyone.

temperament: Leaves a silence rather than filling it.
Notices when a familiar place has changed.
Can be warm after she has chosen to stay.

seed_relationships.note: A few quiet talks were easy. She has not said how much she liked them.
Finds his long stories hard to stay with. He may not know.
